Looking for your Unity build

Build folder

Drop your Unity WebGL export into the site.

  1. Export from Unity using the WebGL platform.
  2. Copy Unity's Build folder into dist/Build.
  3. Copy Unity's TemplateData folder into dist/TemplateData.
  4. Update dist/unity-config.json if your loader file has a different name.
